events.title: Alligo AB: Interim Report Q3 2026 - Organic growth and improved profitability in Finland
events.text: Third quarter 2026 highlights * Revenue increased by 4.9 per cent to MSEK 2,295 (2,189). Organic growth was 1.1 per cent. * Gross margin was 41.1 per cent (41.4). * Adjusted EBITA increased to MSEK 168 (158), corresponding to an adjusted EBITA margin of 7.3 per cent (7.2). * Operating profit increased to MSEK 147 (134) and the operating margin increased to 6.4 per cent (6.1). Operating profit was charged with items affecting comparability of MSEK -4 (-5). * Profit amounted to MSEK 92 (83). * Earnings per share amounted to SEK 1.841 (1.641). * Cash flow from operating activities amounted to MSEK 45 (148). First nine months 2026 highlights * Revenue increased by 5.4 per cent to MSEK 7,264 (6,891). Organic growth was 2.5 per cent. * Gross margin was 40.9 per cent (40.8). * Adjusted EBITA increased to MSEK 468 (376), corresponding to an adjusted EBITA margin of 6.4 per cent (5.5). * Operating profit increased to MSEK 384 (269) and the operating margin increased to 5.3 per cent (3.9). Operating profit was charged with items affecting comparability of MSEK -30 (-52). * Profit amounted to MSEK 238 (146). * Earnings per share amounted to SEK 4.711 (2.861). * Cash flow from operating activities amounted to MSEK 592 (260). 1) Before and after dilution. Significant events during the third quarter * Detailed planning of the intended expansion of the logistics centre in Örebro is continuing according to schedule, with construction on track to begin in 2027. Events after the end of the period * No significant events have occurred since the end of the period. Comments from the CEO | “Alligo delivered continued organic growth and improved profit in the third | quarter, despite a somewhat cautious market.” | | “We have a strong platform and at the same time see many opportunities to | further strengthen our position going forward.” | | “During the quarter, we continued to develop both our sales management and | our prioritisation in order to maximise the effect of our sales work.” | | “We are not expecting a major overhaul, but I am convinced that the further | developed strategy will make us even more relevant for our customers, | strengthen Alligo as a workplace and create even better conditions for | long-term profitable growth.” Presentation of the interim report for the third quarter 2026 Alligo publishes its interim report for the third quarter 2026 on Friday, 23 October 2026, at 08:00 a.m. CEST. In conjunction with this, Alligo is pleased to issue this invitation to a webcast conference call in which Group President & CEO Samuel Alteborg and CFO & Deputy CEO Irene Wisenborn Bellander will present the report and answer any subsequent questions. The presentation will be held in English. Date and time: Friday, 23 October 2026 at 11:00 a.m. CEST Web link: www.alligo.com/en/report/q3-2026/ Telephone conference: https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIc09ccff873be4b099e506b3099e045c7 (https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI38521439b5574be28928d75c620d4033) To participate in the conference call, you need to register via the link above before the conference starts. When you register, you will receive a phone number and a personal code. For further information, please contact: Samuel Alteborg, CEO & President Irene Wisenborn Bellander, CFO & Deputy CEO Phone +46 8 712 00 00 ir@alligo.com This information is information that Alligo is obliged to make public pursuant to the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-10-23 08:00 CEST. About Alligo Alligo is a leading player in workwear, personal protection, tools and consumables in the Nordics. Sales mainly take place through the concept brands Swedol in Sweden and Tools in Norway and Finland, via stores, field sales and telesales, digital sales and on-site service. events.text: Tredje kvartalet 2026 i sammandrag * Nettoomsättningen ökade med 4,9 procent till 2 295 MSEK (2 189). Den organiska tillväxten var 1,1 procent. * Bruttomarginalen uppgick till 41,1 procent (41,4). * Justerad EBITA ökade till 168 MSEK (158), motsvarande en justerad EBITA-marginal om 7,3 procent (7,2). * Rörelseresultatet ökade till 147 MSEK (134) och rörelsemarginalen ökade till 6,4 procent (6,1). Rörelseresultatet belastades med jämförelsestörande poster om -4 MSEK (-5). * Resultatet uppgick till 92 MSEK (83). * Resultat per aktie uppgick till 1,841 SEK (1,641). * Kassaflödet från den löpande verksamheten uppgick till 45 MSEK (148). Nio månader 2026 i sammandrag * Nettoomsättningen ökade med 5,4 procent till 7 264 MSEK (6 891). Den organiska tillväxten var 2,5 procent. * Bruttomarginalen uppgick till 40,9 procent (40,8). * Justerad EBITA ökade till 468 MSEK (376), motsvarande en justerad EBITA-marginal om 6,4 procent (5,5). * Rörelseresultatet ökade till 384 MSEK (269) och rörelsemarginalen ökade till 5,3 procent (3,9). Rörelseresultatet belastades med jämförelsestörande poster om -30 MSEK (-52). * Resultatet uppgick till 238 MSEK (146). * Resultat per aktie uppgick till 4,711 SEK (2,861). * Kassaflödet från den löpande verksamheten uppgick till 592 MSEK (260). 1) Före och efter utspädning. Händelser efter periodens utgång * Inga viktiga händelser efter periodens utgång.
